en.title: Claude Code without the plugin
steps: Listed the video tools on the computer.
Tried to stamp times on frames; the FFmpeg build could not draw text.
Made contact sheets and looked at them. The answer is spoken, not shown.
Searched Python packages and model caches for speech-to-text.
Created a Python environment and downloaded a speech model from the internet.
Transcribed the audio and found the sentence.

zh.title: Claude Code，不装插件
steps: 列出电脑上的视频工具。
想在帧上打时间戳，但这版 FFmpeg 不能绘制文字。
拼出缩略图来看，可答案是说出来的，不在画面里。
在 Python 包和模型缓存里找语音转写工具。
新建 Python 环境，从网上下载语音模型。

en.title: Claude Code with the plugin
steps: Checked what this computer can do.
Transcribed the video on this computer.

zh.title: Claude Code，装上插件
steps: 查看这台电脑能做什么。
